description: Find source-checked smart glasses by country, use case and required features. Returns a bounded shortlist in catalog order, not a best-product ranking. Unknown regional software support does not satisfy required software features. No live inventory or checkout.

country.description: Explicit shopping country; GB means United Kingdom. Independent of interface language.

language.description: Content language, not the shopping country.

query.description: Product name, maker or description text.
